items.headline: Wall Street futures gain as AI enthusiasm offsets oil and yield concerns
items.summary: Reuters reported that U.S. stock-index futures rose as AI optimism offset pressure from oil above $100 per barrel and elevated Treasury yields. Akamai shares surged 21% after the company signed an $11.6 billion cloud-services deal with Anthropic; AMD, Marvell, Cerebras and Intel also rose in premarket trading.

items.headline: AI-focused stocks highlighted among September's strongest performers
items.summary: Investing.com highlighted Intel, AMD, Arm, Natera and Hewlett Packard among stocks with large September gains, while identifying Marvell and Qualcomm as semiconductor companies selected by multiple AI-driven strategies. The article attributes the discussion to Investing.com's AI-powered stock-selection analysis.
